title: WWE SmackDown vs. Raw 2007 (WWE SmackDown vs. Raw 2007 Recomp)
description: Native PC port of WWE SmackDown vs. Raw 2007 (Xbox 360) for Windows, plus Linux and Steam Deck through Proton: static recompilation + native D3D12/Vulkan renderer, 60 fps, up to 4K. Requires your own copy of the game; no game files included, no piracy.
